rules.statement: A donee of rented premises, who has been granted a life interest by the donor, is entitled to claim rent from the tenant upon the donor's death.
rules.supporting_quote: Where a landlord donates the rented premises reserving a life-interest in his favour, the donee is entitled to claim the rent from the tenant on the death of the donor; it is not open to the tenant to continue to remain in possession and refuse to pay rent to the new owner on the pretext that he never attorned to the new owner.
